description: This file defines a data transfer object (UI payload) for creating a checkout order, including validation and schema annotations.

classes.name: CreateCheckoutRequest
classes.description: A record representing the request payload for creating a checkout from a cart, including nested Destination and SelectedShippingQuote records.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Record encapsulating shipping destination details such as country, postal code, and region.

methods.name: SelectedShippingQuote
methods.description: Record encapsulating the selected shipping quote provider and service level information.
